interpretations.business_scale: Cohere is better read through enterprise deployment quality than consumer-scale metrics.
interpretations.customer_adoption: Customer evidence is selective, so retention and expansion remain central missing variables.
interpretations.model_product: Cohere is differentiated by enterprise, retrieval, and private deployment use cases.
interpretations.infrastructure: Compute needs are meaningful but the business is less defined by mass consumer inference than OpenAI.
interpretations.capital: Funding supports enterprise model development, but runway is not externally calculable.
interpretations.valuation: Valuation cannot be normalized without ARR or revenue disclosure.
interpretations.competition: Cohere competes as an enterprise AI platform rather than as a broad consumer assistant.

strengthen: Rerank/retrieval products become default enterprise infrastructure
weaken: Enterprise customers consolidate around hyperscaler platforms
final_interpretation: Cohere is an enterprise-focused AI company whose thesis depends on durable business deployment, retrieval infrastructure, and private-enterprise model adoption rather than consumer distribution.
